name: Amagi Yukiko
source:
One of the main heroines, Yukiko is a second-year at Yasogami High School, [url=/c46285]Yu[/url] and [url=/c51770]Yosuke's[/url] classmate and [url=/c46799]Chie's[/url] best friend. Being the daughter of the owner of the local hot springs inn called the Amagi Inn, she is pressured to be the next one in the line to inherit it. Due to this, she is forced to live a strict life, and her biggest insecurity is being chained down. Her whole life she has felt she is on a railroad track with no opportunity for deviation to the point where she has developed a desire to run away from such life and start anew. After accepting her true self, she gained the ability to wield the Persona, [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Konohana_Sakuya]Konohana Sakuya[/url].

Yukiko is a rich, elegant young woman who is popular with boys and girls alike. Often scoring the best during exams, she is very intelligent and often repeats the material with Chie. At first Yukiko was very reserved, but after being saved she turns livelier. She also truly appreciates and cares about her friends, as well as her parents and staff from the Inn, and often vows to become an even stronger, more dependable person so that one day she, in turn, will be able to support and protect them just like they have did to her in the past. 

Despite her appearance and overall personality, Yukiko is quite airheaded as well - she often misreads situations and tends to have very easy laughing fits from the slightest jokes. She and Chie are both horrible cooks to the point where their food was branded with the name "Myster Food X" because of its terrible appearance and appearance-matching flavor.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Yukiko_Amagi]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
